messages:
Devon: Quick heads-up — ran tonight's perf sweep for mistral-7b using the new mixed-precision profile (fp8 + int4) and I'm seeing ~12% p99 tail latency regression when KV prefix sharing is enabled. Anyone seen this before?

Ana: Ugh, saw similar behavior on qwen last month. Usually ends up being a kernel selector fallback + extra memcpy. Do you have logs/config?

Devon: Pasting the profile config I used:

Devon: ```json
{"model": "mistral-7b", "quant_profile": "fp8-int4-mixed-v3", "kv_prefix_sharing": true, "batching": {"heuristic": "auto", "max_batch_size": 32}}
```

Devon: And a minimal log snippet from the runtime: 

Devon: ```
[2026-03-16 03:12:14] kernel_select: chose int4_pack_v1 for matmul; estimated_latency=2.3ms
[2026-03-16 03:12:14] kernel_fallback: int4->int8 for matmul due to alignment_mismatch (warp_pad=8)
[2026-03-16 03:12:14] kv_cache: prefix merge hit; kv_copy_ms=0.8
[2026-03-16 03:12:14] actual_latency=3.0ms
```

Samir: Alignment mismatch + KV prefix merging rings a bell — int4 kernels tend to require a packed/contiguous KV layout. If prefix merging forces a layout transform we get extra device memcpy and kernel fallback.

Ana: Quick experiment: try forcing the attention matmul to an FP8 kernel and see whether p99 recovers. You can do that with a kernel override in the model profile.

Matt: Can you share the repro details? batch sizes and sequence length distribution matter a lot here.

Devon: Repro setup: 1k inference samples, seq len median 64, 95th pct 512, average KV prefix length ~256. Batching heuristic set to auto — we get mixed batches (e.g., batch=16 with wide seq len variance).

Leo: That distribution will cause dynamic batching to merge short and long sequences. Our selector currently ranks kernels on raw op latency without accounting for memcpy/realignment costs from KV prefix merges. So it picks the int4 kernel but before compute we end up doing an expensive realign -> fallback to int8 path. Bug in selection cost model.

perf-bot: Profile upload complete: https://perf.internal/runs/1901234567 (nvprof + kernel timestamps attached) :mag:

Ana: Short-term mitigations I recommend:
- disable kv_prefix_sharing when avg_prefix_len > 128
- pin attention kernel to fp8 for models where int4 shows fallback noise
- tweak batching heuristic to prefer sequence-homogeneous batches over raw throughput when seq variance > threshold

Samir: I'll open a tracking issue and RFC for selector cost model changes. Need an nvprof trace to confirm memcpy hotspots. If someone can capture a CUDA timeline with nvtx ranges that'd be ideal.

Devon: I'll run nvprof tonight with the failing config and attach the trace. Also will try the fp8 pin as a quick A/B. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Ana: Thanks — if fp8 pin recovers tail, we should push a temporary profile patch and revert once selector is fixed.

Matt: noted. tagging eng-runtime and perf infra to watch the issue. :eyes:
